mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.0% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts above 950 thousand units and retail sales above 400,000 million dollars indicate robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in less than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 7.0), a decline in industrial production below 100 signals an impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 55% of triggered instances within late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls level above 135,000 thousand persons indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
